text:
Elena: PolarFreight updated invoice for PO#90321 — FX delta +6.5%, added currency handling fee; RMA freight +€14,500. Need fast decision on air vs sea.
Marc: Can EU spares cover immediate demand?
Soojin: EU pool can spare 8 units for ~7 days, APAC tight.
Hugo (Finance): Finance can approve up to €8k for expedite from contingency.
Elena: Vendor offers 50/50 expedite if we accept consolidated AWB and allow our broker for half; they will not invoice in EUR.
Marc: Consolidate AWB, route 10 units via NordSea, request depot photos and single HS line. If vendor stalls, move noncritical units to LCL (+~12d).
PolarFreight-AM: Confirmed consolidation and NordSea OK; offering €3k credit, currency fee remains. Carrier cut in 6h.
Elena: Decision: approve air with our share capped at €5.5k (Hugo will provision €5.5k), ask vendor for manifest + depot PODs by EOD.
LogiBot: INF-4800 created for impacted node and spare reassign task.
